En Forever casi toda la comida da un 5 %: In Forever almost all food gives 5% more experience per kill, on top of stats (seen in the beta). And Cooking is the base of camping: its fire becomes the Basic Campfire, and cooks craft improved campfires that hold 5 to 10 objects.

Each object has three ranks: the first is learned at skill 20 (Cooking's Basic Campfire, at 1) and each rank includes the previous one. <span class=\"sig\" title=\"Mejora\">▲</: ▲Various talents no longer have a reduced chance to trigger from low-rank spells. Exception: Blizzard still triggers Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost less often with a rank learned more than 12 levels below yours.

<span class=\"sig\" title=\"Mejora\">▲</: ▲For launch, creatures respawn faster in many zones, especially low-level ones (starting zones the fastest). Rates slow down as you level and will return to normal once the launch surge settles.

BLIZZARD · OFFICIAL NOTES · NOVEMBER 2

Blizzard changes all nine classes

More damage for every class and more health for high-level enemies. Shank for rogues, goodbye Lava Burst and Salvation, and much more threat for tanks. All in Spanish and English.
<span class=\"badge-new\">ÚLTIMA HORA</s:
BREAKING

BLIZZARD · NOVEMBER 2

Blizzard changes all nine classes two days before launch

Last notes before launch: every class deals more damage and high-level enemies have more health. Druids and hunters hit much harder, warriors and bears generate much more threat, rogues get Shank, shamans swap Lava Burst for Call of Thunder, Blessing of Salvation is gone, Shadow Word: Death punishes harder and warlock pets have far less health. Training from 1 to 60 costs about 206 gold. Blizzard doesn't expect big changes until the December raids.
